changelog:
Initial public release of the Hotbutter voice chat skill (hosted relay):

- Connects local agents to voice chat via the hotbutter.ai relay.
- Transcribes speech in the browser and sends only text (not audio) through the relay.
- Runs the openclaw agent CLI locally in response to each message.
- Configurable relay URL and agent display name for privacy/personalization.
- On first run, optionally collects email for setup; all data except transcripts and responses stays local.
summary: Enables local voice chat by embedding Hotbutter relay server and PWA, providing speech-to-text and text-to-speech via a secure, self-hosted connection.
